algorithm: {This priority algorithm assigns each bin a score equal to the negative of the remaining capacity after inserting the given item, using negative infinity for bins where the item cannot fit, so higher scores correspond to bins where the item would fit with the least leftover space.}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    return np.where(bins >= item, -(bins - item), -np.inf)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    scores[valid_mask] = -(bins[valid_mask] - item)
    return scores
